Required DNS records in Cloudflare:

A      apfel-park.de           46.225.23.177
A      www                     46.225.23.177
A      mail                    46.225.23.177
MX     apfel-park.de           mail.apfel-park.de  priority 10
TXT    apfel-park.de           v=spf1 mx -all
TXT    _dmarc                  v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:postmaster@apfel-park.de; adkim=s; aspf=s
TXT    mail._domainkey         v=DKIM1; k=rsa; 

Also required outside Cloudflare DNS records:
- PTR / reverse DNS for 46.225.23.177 -> mail.apfel-park.de

Cloudflare proxy rules:
- `apfel-park.de` and `www` may be proxied
- `mail` must be DNS only
